set.body: Per decision q-binocular. Recording stays monocular; BinocularRecording[U] holds paired samples and projects to left, right, or cyclopean(Fusion), plus a vergence signal. Type lands v0.3 so that v0.6 ASC ingest cannot silently drop an eye. Binocular ANALYSES (vergence, disparity, coordination) deferred past v1.0.
set.title: BinocularRecording with left/right/cyclopean projections
